Les données contenues dans ces supports et documents sont strictement couvertes par le secret professionnel (article 226-13 du code pénal). Conformément aux articles 34 et 35 de la loi du 6 janvier 1978 modifiée relative à l’informatique, aux fichiers et aux libertés, le titulaire du présent accord-cadre s’engage à prendre toutes précautions utiles afin de préserver la sécurité des informations et notamment d’empêcher qu’elles ne soient déformées, endommagées ou communiquées à des personnes non autorisées. Le titulaire s’engage donc à respecter, de façon absolue, les obligations suivantes et à les faire respecter par son personnel, c’est-à-dire notamment à : Ne prendre aucune copie des documents et supports d’informations confiés, à l’exception de celles nécessaires pour les besoins de l’exécution de sa prestation, objet du présent accord-cadre Ne pas utiliser les documents et informations traités à des fins autres que celles spécifiées au présent accord-cadre Ne pas divulgue

Protecting our environment is a huge responsibility, and we work with a number of organisations that carry out specific environmental functions. As of August 2014, we are also responsible for ensuring that the people of Ireland are protected from the harmful effects of radiation. deliverables_scope.text: o empower and better resource the Centre to support Ireland’s collective national effort to reverse biodiversity loss and contribute to nature restoration. The primary role of the Centre is to contribute to building the knowledge base on biodiversity and track how it is changing in Ireland. It works to ensure that data and information on Ireland’s biodiversity is more freely available and accessible for use in research, conservation management and decision-making. The National Biodiversity Data Centre is a predominantly publicly funded entity, rather than a public sector body. The Centre formally became a registered charity in November 2025. Requirements This Request for Quotation (RFQ) is a below-threshold competitive procurement process for printing services conducted in line with the National Public Procurement Policy Framework and relevant OGP guidance for goods and services. Quotations are being sought from suitably qualified suppliers for a three-year contract for printing services. This RFQ is being issued to all interested suppliers via public notice. Introduction The Administrative Office of the United States Courts (AO) is seeking contractor services for the printing and mailing of the following Internal Revenue Service (IRS) information returns: • W-2, Wage and Tax Statement • 1099-R, Distributions from Pensions, Annuities, Retirement or Profit-Sharing Plans, IRAs, Insurance Contracts, etc. • 1099-INT, Interest Income • 1099-MISC, Miscellaneous Income • 1099-NEC Nonemployee Compensation The printing and mailing support service will allow the Federal Judiciary to accomplish the requirement on the annual IRS tax reporting obligations. This contract will be for printing and mailing services ONLY and DOES NOT include the contractor providing any other tax-related services. The AO will provide ready-to-print and mail Portable Document File (PDF) data files to the contractor with all W-2 and 1099 boxes prepopulated with the appropriate tax information along with appropriate instructions of each tax form.
